title: Shared review of recipe catalog rollout
description: Perform the final integration review across implementation, tests, and docs. Focus on behavior parity, threading correctness, API suitability for future search/filter work, and whether obsolete discovery paths were fully retired without regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Review confirms the final code satisfies all in-scope acceptance criteria from the spec and does not introduce out-of-scope behavior.
Review checks for threading and state-management risks, especially background parsing, main-actor publication, and reload semantics that preserve prior results.
Review verifies tests and documentation align with the shipped implementation and flags any residual follow-up work separately from this spec.
